claim: A quoted key that uses the TOML 8-digit \U escape is not decoded: json.loads rejects \U, so the fallback returns the raw text with the backslash escape still in it.
what_goes_wrong: A user config.toml whose dropped table or key is spelled with a TOML \UXXXXXXXX escape (e.g. "\U0000006dcp_servers".x) is not recognized, so lean_config keeps the mcp_servers table that a worker must not inherit.
fix_idea: Before json.loads, rewrite \UXXXXXXXX into the character (or decode with a small TOML-escape routine) so 8-digit escapes are handled like \u.

claim: A quoted table name written with a TOML \UXXXXXXXX escape ("\U0000006dcp_servers" is mcp_servers) is not decoded. first_key falls back to the raw text when json.loads rejects \U, so the dropped table is kept.
what_goes_wrong: A user config.toml with a table header written with a TOML \UXXXXXXXX escape (e.g. ["\U0000006dcp_servers".x]) keeps the mcp_servers table in the lean worker config, so workers inherit MCP servers that the lean home is meant to drop.
fix_idea: In first_key, decode \UXXXXXXXX (and the other TOML escapes) by hand, or convert \U escapes to a form json.loads accepts, instead of falling back to the raw text.

claim: If the snippet writes to stdout without a final newline before run() returns, the JSON result line is glued to that text, so no line starts with '{' and run_snippet reports 'no output' even though run() succeeded.
what_goes_wrong: A repro snippet (or the code it calls) that writes to stdout without a trailing newline glues the JSON result line onto that text, so run_snippet reports 'no output' and the repro is graded as a failure although run() succeeded.
fix_idea: In RUNNER, write a newline before the JSON line (after flushing stdout), so the result always starts on its own line.

claim: The comment says only space, tab and CR are space around a line and any other character is content, but VERDICT_LINE uses \s, so a trailing NBSP (or form feed) is stripped and the line is accepted.
what_goes_wrong: A final line 'VERDICT: PASS - ok' followed by NBSP or form feed is accepted because VERDICT_LINE's \s* / \s*$ strip it, although the comment and test say only space, tab and CR are padding, so hpflow may read a verdict that Puppetmaster's parse_terminal_verdict rejects.
fix_idea: Replace \s in VERDICT_LINE with explicit [ \t\r] classes, and add a trailing-NBSP case to the test.
